@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M4NXQSMZF2TE7AP0GW9G6HM8
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'Queue metrics: Mailbox records depth and task timing for each letter'
+---
+## What
+
+`Mailbox` (`Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/ModelPool/Mailbox.swift:16`, a public generic class) is a queue, but it records no metric. No code in this repo uses it now, but other packages of the family can use it. Connect it to the shared `QueueTelemetry` recorder of task `w9g6hm8`.
+
+Approach:
+- Add init parameters for a fixed queue name (default `mailbox`) and an optional `ModelRef` (default `nil`). Keep `public init()` (`:50`) so that the public API does not break. `QueueTelemetry` is internal, thus the public init takes a name and a `ModelRef`, and makes the `QueueTelemetry` inside.
+- One letter is one queue task. Keep the `QueueTicket` of each letter in the locked state, next to the letter.
+  - `enqueued` at `post(_:)` (`:64`). `postAndWait(_:)` (`:81`) calls `post`, so it records one task only.
+  - `started` when a batch takes the letter: `takeJoining(admitting:)` (`:142`), the private `nextBatch(isolation:joining:)` (`:199`), which `answerNextBatch` (`:168`) calls.
+  - `completed` with `succeeded` or `failed` when the letter gets its answer.
+  - `completed` with `cancelled` for `cancel(_:)` (`:95`) of a letter that did not start, and for each waiting letter that the deinit gives `CancellationError`.
+- The depth is the count of letters in the queue plus the letters in the running batch.
+- Make the metric objects at call time. Add no telemetry string literal outside `ExtrasTelemetry.swift`. Never record the message or the answer.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `Mailbox()` compiles with no change at each call site. A caller can give a queue name and a `ModelRef`.
+- [ ] Each letter records `queue.wait`, `queue.run` and one `queue.tasks` count when it completes, with `queue.name` and the correct `queue.outcome`.
+- [ ] A letter that is cancelled before a batch takes it records a wait time, no run time, and `cancelled`.
+- [ ] The depth meter goes up at `post` and goes back to 0 when each letter has its answer or its cancel.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/ModelPool/MailboxTests.swift`: with `MetricsTestKit` `TestMetrics` through `withMetricsFactory`, test the depth values, the timers and the dimensions for a batch that succeeds, a batch that fails, a cancel before start, and a joined letter from `takeJoining`.
+- [ ] A content-safety test with `TelemetryCapture.run(forbidding:)` from `Tests/TelemetryTestSupport/TelemetryCapture.swift`, with a message text that must not show.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+#telemetry #feature
\ No newline at end of file
